description: A compact list of groceries with a small picture and an add button.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Groceries as a compact list: a small square picture (or none), the name, the pack size, the price and an add
  button, in one or two columns. Axes: thumbs (show, hide), cols (1, 2), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

  export type GroceryListProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    thumbs?: "show" | "hide";
    cols?: "1" | "2";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import AddIcon from "../components/add-icon.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    thumbs = "show",
    cols = "2",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: GroceryListProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="shopping-bag" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <List
      tag="ul"
      class={
        (cols as string) === "2" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 md:grid-cols-2"
        : "grid grid-cols-1"
      }
      data-slot="items"
    >
      {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
        <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-4 border-b border-border py-2" data-slot="item">
          {#if ((thumbs as string) === "show")}
            <MediaFrame alt={d.name} ratio="1/1" class="size-12 shrink-0" />
          {/if}
          <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {d.name}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {tpl("{0} · {1}", d.weight, d.tag)}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Inline class="text-sm font-bold">
            {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
          </Inline>
          <AddIcon label={tpl(labels.addOf, d.name)} />
        </ListItem>
      {/each}
    </List>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
